station_selection: government PM2.5 station with at least 75 percent published hourly coverage across 2022-2025; chosen using availability only, before model fitting
heating_proxy: 15 October through 14 April, by target local date, not official annual heating dates
dm_hac_lags: max(24,horizon-1); Bartlett weights; covariances use true hourly spacing including missing observations
test_selection: identical eligible issue times for all five models at each horizon; target must be observed and pass quality control; issue and target must remain in the same split
pretraining_data_check: ERA5 boundary_layer_height has 4368 missing hourly values in the requested archive. Excluded from every model before tuning rather than filling with future data.
